item.title: Help Shape the New Columbus Community Sports Park
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Help Shape the New Columbus Community Sports Park 

As the Columbus Crew prepares to move downtown, our community has a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to shape 25 acres of new green space, park space and recreational programming on the near-northeast side of the City.

The Columbus Community Sports Park will be a new, centrally-located park and recreation space that will benefit nearby neighborhoods, the City and the region. It will provide much-needed access to park and recreation space to the 200,000 residents who live within three miles of the site. Facilities, fields and green space will be easily accessible to neighborhoods including: Milo Grogan, Weinland Park, Linden, North Columbus, Glen Echo, Indianola Trace, University District, Clintonville and others.

The Columbus Community Sports Park will be located on the grounds of Historic Crew Stadium and adjacent to the Ohio State Fairgrounds along Interstate 71, between East 17th Avenue and Hudson Street.

The Community Sports Park has two primary components. The first is facilities for organized – formal – sports programs. These will be available for rent by families, local teams, traveling leagues and others. These could include multi-use wood courts, tournament-level synthetic turf fields, indoor field space, meeting rooms, classrooms, a rock climbing wall, a concessions area or covered outdoor Pickleball courts.

The second is informal sports and community park spaces, which will be available at no cost to residents and teams.  These could include mixed-use grass fields,  basketball courts, walking and bicycling trails with exercise stations, green space with an outdoor courtyard or plaza, open shelters, picnic tables, a playground, a splash pad or a skate park.

Share your Ideas!

The City is asking for feedback on the activities and facilities that residents would like to have at the new Columbus Community Sports Park. Take the survey and give your input today: http://bit.ly/ccspsurvey21.

Learn more and sign up for project updates at CRPDSports.org/CommunitySportsPark.

item.title: You're Invited: New Columbus Community Sports Park Survey
item.description:
Columbus Community Sports Park Survey Invitation

Share your input to help shape the new facility

The City of Columbus is excited to announce the development of a new sports park adjacent to Mapfre Stadium. This new facility will be a significant step in the City's efforts to find new ways to serve the recreation needs of our community.

To help with this important project, the City is conducting research regarding amateur and recreational sports venues in central Ohio, and what features the local and regional sports community would like to see in the new sports park. As a potential user of the new facility, the City welcomes your input on important topics such as satisfaction with the facilities you currently use and how the new sports park can meet your needs. You can easily share your feedback through an online survey. 

Click here to access the survey or copy and paste the link below in your browser. Please enter the email address where you received this invitation to access the survey.

https://CCSP.sawtoothsoftware.com/login.html

The survey takes approximately 10 minutes to complete. Please complete this survey by Jan. 13, 2021.

Thank you for your feedback - we appreciate your insight!
